scope: Haiku tier rules, per-tier effort caps, the outcome feedback loop and its weekly review for the model-router fork (code2-workspace #162)

fact_evidence.one_writer: One agent session edits the tiers-feedback worktree; no other claim or lane touches model-router (git worktree list).
fact_evidence.reversible: Tier and effort values are constants in hooks/lib/pricing.ts and revert with git; the report and review scripts only write dated log files.
fact_evidence.boundary_known: hooks/lib/pricing.ts, hooks/register.tsx and hooks/router.test.ts in this repository; scripts/router_report.py and scripts/router_review.py in code2-workspace (merged as PR #179).

rationale: One writer, a reversible change to constants and two log-writing scripts, and a known boundary: durable_solo. No migration, shared contract or external mutation.
